preconditions.description: The number of polyhedrons n must be between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s in {'Tetrahedron', 'Cube', 'Octahedron', 'Dodecahedron', 'Icosahedron'} for s in polyhedrons)
preconditions.description: Each polyhedron name must be one of the five valid types.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of faces calculated from the input polyhedrons.
